editorial:
Imagine being snatched as a kid and raised by five different criminals who all claim to be your father. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow Hwayi, a boy who grows up in a hidden house in the woods, learning how to fight, shoot, and survive from his five mentors. At first, it feels like a weirdly sweet family bond, but you quickly realize these men are dangerous killers. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you wonder if Hwayi will actually love these men or eventually turn on them as he discovers the truth about his past.

The acting is top-notch, especially the kid who plays Hwayi since he has to go through a huge emotional change. The action scenes are punchy and the plot twists really keep you guessing until the end. While the middle part slows down a bit, the finale is an absolute blast. You should definitely check this out if you like dark crime stories with a lot of heart.
endingExplained: Hwayi eventually learns that his five fathers actually kidnapped him and killed his real parents. He decides to take revenge and lures all five men into a final battle at their home. After a bloody fight, he kills every single one of them. In the end, he finds his birth mother, but he realizes he cannot go back to a normal life after everything he has done. He walks away alone, forever changed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty revenge stories and unexpected family twists.
